results.title: Facilities maintenance change request
results.description: A department requests planned maintenance or a modification to office facilities, such as lighting, air conditioning, or meeting-room equipment.
results.resolution: Submit a facilities change request describing the work, location, expected impact, preferred schedule, and safety considerations. Obtain facilities approval before implementation.

results.title: Office layout change request
results.description: A team requests a change to desk layout, seating arrangements, or shared office space.
results.resolution: Submit a workplace change request describing the requested layout, affected area, business reason, and preferred timing. Obtain facilities and management approval before work begins.

results.title: Office access or badge arrangement change
results.description: An employee requests an approved change to physical office access, access-card assignment, or entry arrangements.
results.resolution: Submit a request to the authorized facilities or security team with employee details, location, requested access, and business justification. Obtain required approvals before making changes.
